user_story:
As a user, I want to submit a contact form so that I can get in touch with the company. The form should validate input fields before submission. 
Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The form must not submit if 'Your first name *' (input with id 'first_name') is empty. 
2. The form must not submit if 'Your last name *' (input with id 'last_name') is empty. 
3. The form must not submit if 'Your email *' (input with id 'email') is empty. 
4. The form must not submit if 'Select a subject *' (select with id 'subject') is not selected. 
5. The form must redirect to a success page if submitted successfully with all required fields filled. 
6. The form must retain visibility of 'Contact' heading (h1 element) upon submission failure.
